applicability_rule: a problem is applicable to an arm iff: requires.jacobian is 'analytic' and problem.jacobian == 'analytic', or 'jvp' and problem.jvp, or 'any' (analytic or jvp); requires.structure is null or equals problem.structure; requires.mass is true (the arm accepts a non-identity mass matrix) or problem.mass is false; requires.fixed_dimension is null or (contains problem.dimension and the problem is not a callback-fault probe: the compile-time-N arms integrate their own built-in copy of the base problem, which an injected callback fault cannot reach); requires.autonomous is false or problem.autonomous. `applicable_problems` lists the result; `triage-run` exits 2 for an inapplicable pair or an unwired arm.

arms.unwired_reason: the sequential stage solver refuses step-indexed initial guesses (rodas5p-integrators sequential.rs:401-404: "step-indexed initial guesses are supported by the matrix-free U-form fast driver only"); InitialGuess::PreviousStep{,Scaled} is reachable only through the U-form driver (arm mf-x0-prevstep)
